Hi Sam — thanks for the context. Quick technical notes to help scope:
- If you want on-prem (air-gapped) we’ll cover packaging, install pre-reqs (NVIDIA drivers, container runtime), and an ops playbook. That typically needs a 60–90m deep dive and an ops contact.
- For VPC private (our usual private control plane + customer VPC peering), 45m is usually sufficient: networking, KMS integration, audit logs, and a short failover discussion.

Can you confirm which route you’re leaning toward? Also — please advise whether your security team requires us to present an architecture diagram beforehand. We can attach an anonymized reference diagram.

I’ll prepare a short checklist (required ports, certs, KMS flows) to share before the call.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
